scripts.build: bun run --filter logic-sdk build && bun run --filter @logic-sdk/cli build
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:package && bun run --filter '*' test
scripts.check:package: cd packages/logic-sdk && publint --strict && attw --pack --profile esm-only && cd ../cli && publint --strict
